entries.text: SingleStore Write Primitives CSV bulk loads now abort on non-numeric text in the DECIMAL `o_totalprice` column instead of loading it as 0.00, and the SCD Type 2 cleanup statements use a date literal SingleStore accepts.
SingleStore keeps FULL OUTER JOIN as written and returns the grand-total row for ROLLUP over empty input, so TPC-DS queries 18 and 97 return the expected row counts.
SingleStore loads Parquet files in 1,000,000-row chunks, so the 14.8M-row JoinOrder movie_info table loads on a 4 GiB stack.
